About Alphastream

Alphastream is an AI-native technology company transforming how leading private capital firms access, analyze, and operationalize investment data. Our platform combines deep private markets domain expertise, advanced AI, and structured data intelligence to power critical workflows across the private credit investment lifecycle—from origination, due diligence, and deal structuring to execution, portfolio monitoring, and investment operations. Working with some of the world's largest alternative asset managers, Alphastream is building the foundational data and intelligence layer for the next generation of private markets workflows.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst with strong private credit domain expertise to work at the intersection of institutional clients, financial markets, and cutting-edge AI technology. This is a highly visible, client-facing role for someone who understands how private credit investment teams operate, can identify opportunities to improve their workflows, and can translate complex business challenges into innovative technology solutions. You will work directly with investment professionals, credit analysts, portfolio managers, legal teams, and operations leaders at leading private capital firms to understand their business needs and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making.

You will also play an important role in developing and enhancing Alphastream's private credit taxonomies and data frameworks, ensuring that complex financial and legal concepts are accurately represented, standardized, and operationalized within our AI-powered platform.

Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Business Solutions

Serve as a trusted domain expert to leading private credit managers, engaging directly with investment, legal, portfolio management, and operations teams.
Develop a deep understanding of clients' investment processes, data requirements, existing workflows, and operational challenges.
Lead client discovery sessions and workshops to identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and AI-driven solutions.
Work collaboratively with clients to conceptualize solutions that address complex business challenges and deliver measurable value.
Translate business needs into clearly defined use cases, functional requirements, business rules, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
Support proof-of-concept engagements, product demonstrations, solution validation, and client adoption.

Solution Development & Engineering Collaboration

Partner closely with engineering and data science teams to design and build innovative, industry-leading private credit solutions.
Translate complex financial concepts, investment processes, and documentation requirements into actionable specifications for technical teams.
Provide domain expertise to guide the development of AI models, document intelligence capabilities, structured data extraction, analytical tools, and intelligent workflows.
Work iteratively with engineers and data scientists to evaluate solution approaches, refine functionality, and improve the quality of outputs.
Collaborate with engineering and data science teams to operationalize private credit taxonomies within AI models, data extraction pipelines, validation frameworks, and downstream analytical workflows.
Assess the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and business relevance of AI-generated outputs, identify gaps, and work with technical teams to address them.
Help design scalable, reusable solutions that address common challenges across institutional clients rather than isolated client-specific requirements.
Participate actively throughout the development lifecycle—from initial concept and solution design through testing, validation, deployment, and continuous improvement.
Identify opportunities to leverage emerging AI technologies to enhance existing capabilities and solve previously difficult or manual business problems.

Private Credit Domain Expertise & Taxonomy Development

Provide subject matter expertise across the private credit lifecycle, including origination, underwriting, structuring, execution, portfolio monitoring, and investment operations.
Apply a strong understanding of credit agreements, loan terms, financial covenants, debt structures, borrower financials, and investment documentation.

Ensure solutions accurately reflect the nuances of private credit transactions and the practical needs of investment professionals.
Stay current with evolving private credit market practices, documentation standards, and industry developments.

Identify common requirements and emerging needs across client engagements that can be addressed through reusable product capabilities.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and data science teams to evaluate new features and improve existing solutions.
Help ensure Alphastream's solutions remain differentiated, innovative, and aligned with evolving institutional client needs.

Required

3+ years of relevant experience in private credit, direct lending, leveraged finance, structured credit, or financial technology serving these markets.

Practical familiarity with credit agreements, loan documentation, financial statements, covenants, and debt structures.

Experience working with engineering, data science, or technology teams to design, develop, or enhance financial applications or data-driven solutions.
Ability to translate complex financial concepts and business processes into clear, actionable specifications for technical teams.
Ability to analyze complex private credit documentation and translate financial and legal concepts into structured taxonomies, standardized data definitions, and business rules.
Strong analytical skills, including the ability to evaluate data quality, investigate discrepancies, define business rules, and validate solution outputs.
Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Experience developing or maintaining financial data taxonomies, data dictionaries, or standardized financial data models.

Independently translate complex business problems into well-defined solutions that engineering and data science teams can build and deliver.
Develop and continuously enhance robust private credit taxonomies that support accurate, consistent, and scalable data intelligence across the platform.

Join Bounce AI's Operations team as a Senior Risk Analyst, where you will play a crucial role in identifying and managing potential risks to ensure the company's stability and growth.
Responsibilities:
Analyze financial and operational data to identify potential risks.
Develop and implement risk management strategies.
Monitor and report on risk levels and compliance with policies.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess risk impact.
Prepare comprehensive risk assessment reports for management.
Conduct regular risk audits and provide recommendations for improvement.

About Us:

Bounce
is a fintech startup revolutionizing debt recovery for consumers and creditors with our best-in-class product. By leveraging the power of AI and automation, we create user-friendly experiences that drive positive outcomes for all parties involved.
With a team based in Israel and New York, we have been growing rapidly. We support hundreds of thousands of consumers on their journey to financial resilience and build partnerships with top creditors and fintech companies.

How You’ll Spend Your Time:

Acquisition Underwriting

Evaluate incoming debt-sale opportunities by building loan-level and cohort-level collection and cash-flow forecasts and recommending bid pricing, expressed in cents on the dollar.
Stratify portfolios by product type, balance band, delinquency/age, state (statute-of-limitations exposure), and account attributes to understand what drives value.
Run seller data due diligence: completeness and fill rates, balance reconciliation to the tape, documentation/media availability, chain of title, bankruptcy/deceased scrubs, and prior placement history.
Build return models — IRR, MOIC, NPV/discounting, hurdle achievement — and stress-test the assumptions that matter most.
Translate underwriting assumptions into explicit, monitorable post-purchase expectations so we can later measure actual vs. underwritten.

Portfolio Surveillance

Track actual collection curves against underwritten curves by batch and vintage.
Maintain IRR/MOIC tracking against hurdle targets; flag underperformance early.
Partner with Data Science on estimated remaining collections (ERC) recalibration.
Diagnose return gaps by connecting them to operational drivers (outreach cadence, right-party contact, conversion, break/keep rates) and population factors (bankruptcy, bad contact data).
Produce recurring portfolio-risk reporting for leadership.

Building the Function

Help establish the risk playbook: underwriting standards, pricing methodology, monitoring cadence, and escalation thresholds.
Codify reusable analyses and write documentation for clarity and replicability.
Work with leadership to define risk appetite and the guardrails around it.

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in risk management software and tools.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
Experience in the technology or AI industry (Preferred).
